messages.text: tell your new fella im looking forward to meeting him

ill keep him in, sorry

the 28th is a long way off for someone with a front door

blocking me on there doesnt stop me knowing where you drink
whats wrong with you
because you made me like this. ill see you about

and if i dont

nothing. just saying itd be a shame, thats all

im not going to forget it. im going to wait
i know youve read these
ive asked you not to message me
and ill stop when you give me five minutes of your time

morning

before you block this one as well, just read it

yeah the car wouldnt start

because you wont answer. thats on you not me
another late one for you today then
i was here at 8
thats not what the door log says. ill keep checking it, dont worry

nothing you say is private, thats the whole problem with you
one more chance to reply nicely
im at my nans funeral
and yet the phone works. noted
ive put what you said in the group
that was between us
they all agree with me by the way. ask them yourself
whos amy from the gym

if theres nothing in it you wouldnt care that i had

then it wont bother you if i drive past will it
get changed before we go
whats wrong with this
nothing, if you dont mind being looked at. go and change
ill come in with you to the doctors
id sooner go by myself
and id rather know what youre telling them. ill drive
youre not doing that course

good girl. it was only going to come between us anyway
